review.assessment: The change replaces the unimplemented stubs in `src/lib.rs` with a complete implementation of `RingBuffer<T>`, fully covering the requested public API (`new`, `push`, `len`, `is_empty`, `to_vec`) and satisfying the overwrite-wrapping behavior. It initializes internal state to track logical length and physical start index, correctly handling circular overwrites during insertion and reconstructing chronological order on extraction. The implementation safely handles edge cases such as zero capacity without panics or logic errors.
